purpose: A public-source discovery and falsification screen of already published CSI index rules. It is not a formal strategy replay, an investable universe, a product recommendation or a selection of target weights.

source.provider: China Securities Index official public history endpoint
limitations: The capture does not establish an authorised point-in-time product-level market-data feed.
Index values do not establish the availability, cost, tax, liquidity, account access or executable tracking of an actual investor product.
Historical values that predate an index's publication, if returned, are treated as methodology back-history rather than live investable history unless independently established otherwise.

fixed_window.return_metric: annualised close-to-close index-value return over each complete rolling five-year calendar interval
fixed_window.treatment: Evaluate each published index independently. No optimization, blending, substitution, cost assumption, tax assumption or investor cash-flow is applied.
fixed_window.window_algorithm: For each observed end date D, select the latest observed close on or before D minus five calendar years. Retain the window only if elapsed days are at least 1,825 and no more than 1,832; annualise as (close_D / close_start)^(365 / elapsed_days) - 1.

predeclared_indices.name: CSI 300 Total Return Index
predeclared_indices.selection_basis: Published CSI total-return version of a broad A-share benchmark.

predeclared_indices.name: CSI Dividend Total Return Index
predeclared_indices.selection_basis: Published CSI total-return version of the dividend equity index used by the published cross-asset rules below.

predeclared_indices.name: CSI Dividend Equity and Bond Risk Parity Index
predeclared_indices.selection_basis: Published CSI methodology combines H00922 with a 0-5 year investment-grade credit-bond coupon strategy through a risk-parity rule.

predeclared_indices.name: CSI Dividend Equity and Bond Constant Proportion 10/90 Index
predeclared_indices.selection_basis: First member of the published 10/90, 20/80 and 30/70 constant-proportion family.

predeclared_indices.name: CSI Dividend Equity and Bond Constant Proportion 20/80 Index
predeclared_indices.selection_basis: Second member of the published constant-proportion family.

predeclared_indices.name: CSI Dividend Equity and Bond Constant Proportion 30/70 Index
predeclared_indices.selection_basis: Third member of the published constant-proportion family.

decision_rules: Preserve the raw official response, request URL, retrieval timestamp and SHA-256 before calculating a metric.
A missing, malformed or incomplete response is reported as unavailable and is not filled from a third-party source.
Every index with at least one complete five-year window is reported; no result is dropped because it conflicts with the 5% threshold.
A value at or above 5% only means that this cost-free public index observation passes this weak discovery condition. It cannot promote an index, fund, ETF or portfolio to T2/T3/T4.
A value below 5% rejects that published index as support for the stronger objective over the observed window.
prohibited_inferences: A 5% future return, guarantee, probability or annual floor.
An investor total-return result after actual fund tracking, spreads, brokerage fees, taxes or account constraints.
A selection of a real product, target allocation, reinvestment rule or order.
A conclusion about direct equities, REITs, futures, offshore instruments or any asset not represented by the exact published index rule.
